rule.candidate: An existing positive first-six context stays positive only if every available changed punctuation reading on the same native spans remains >=0.5. No backfilling, expanding, moving or promoting the initial contexts. Missing required readings preserve the ordinary finding and count unavailable.
rule.design: Full retained source groups outside the prior OCR comparison. Source-disjoint for punctuation evaluation, previously scored in different writing comparisons.
rule.gate: Zero original useful generated files lost for each publisher and generator. >=2 fewer ordinary false groups total and gains in >=2 source cohorts. >=12 generated files with changed contexts across at least two cohorts and two generators. Require complete bound comparisons. No whole-document weight.
rule.second: Compare two-model agreement separately on exactly the original positive contexts. Guard requires both responses stay positive in each of their same bounded punctuation readings. Research across inputs, including shapes outside the currently served second-check format.
rule.useful: One exact context covers >=50% of known edited non-whitespace characters and has >=30% non-whitespace intersection over union.
rule.variants: Change only spaced U+002D/U+2013/U+2014 to U+002D or U+2014, change curly quotes/apostrophes to ASCII, or substitute U+2019 for straight apostrophes between letters. No lexical, whitespace, or sentence edit. Each rendered document must preserve exact sentence boundaries and paragraph membership.
